name: Mathis Stolz
headline: Building agentic AI that masters industrial product complexity | CDTM | TUM | MIT
summary:
Co-founded nexwise to solve a constraint most industrial manufacturers manage but rarely fix: technical product expertise doesn't scale. This forces costly tradeoffs – between revenue growth and service quality, new customers and existing ones, portfolio breadth and expertise depth. We help companies remove these trade-offs rather than live with them – by injecting deep portfolio expertise into global sales and service structures with AI agents. So our customers unlock new revenues across languages without increasing OpEx.





About me:

Trained in systems thinking. Studied mgmt & economics as an undergrad. 4+ years of experience in early to mid-stage technology companies. Went back to university to pursue academic interests + compuscience 101. Strong sympathy for the humanities. Love for (electronic) music and rowing.

positions.title: Co-founder & CCO
positions.description:
Originating at Technical University Munich, nexwise makes deep product knowledge accessible and scalable – so expert capacity no longer becomes the bottleneck.

Product expertise is the binding constraint on revenue growth for industrial manufacturers. When it doesn't scale, both executives and operational doers face forced tradeoffs: protect strategic accounts or cover the market, serve existing customers or win new ones, go deep on core products or leverage the full portfolio.

nexwise removes these tradeoffs with purpose-built agents that run on our proprietary harmonized product graph. 

Reach out if you want to join our mission or explore what we are building.

company.name: nexwise
company.tagline: When product expertise doesn't scale, industrial manufacturers face costly tradeoffs. We remove them.
company.description:
Product expertise is the binding constraint on revenue growth for industrial manufacturers. When it doesn't scale, executives face forced tradeoffs: protect strategic accounts or cover the market, serve existing customers or win new ones, go deep on core products or leverage the full portfolio.

These tradeoffs create revenue leakage, longer sales cycles, and service degradation – especially when demand spikes or complexity increases.
nexwise removes these tradeoffs. 

We make deep product knowledge accessible and scalable across technical sales, support, and service – so expert capacity no longer becomes the bottleneck for revenue.
